outcome: Kitten mucous membrane colour at birth
cohort: The cohort consisted of 14 queens admitted to the Veterinary Teaching Hospital of the University of Bologna for dystocia and undergoing emergency caesarean section, along with their 50 kittens.
finding: Both alfaxalone and propofol were demonstrated to be feasible for the induction of general anaesthesia in cats undergoing c-section, with overall high kitten survival rates (90% at birth, 90.2% at 24 hours).
